description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AuthorizationContextType' used for representing types of authorization contexts in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for handling the type string, comparison, equality checks, and string representation, and is part of an authorization framework.

classes.name: AuthorizationContextType
classes.description: An abstract class representing the type information of authorization contexts, implementing CharSequence and Comparable to enable flexible string-like operations and ordering based on the type string.

methods.name: AuthorizationContextType
methods.description: Constructor initializing the authorization context type with a non-null, non-empty string.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the type string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index of the type string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the type string from start to end indices.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this authorization context type to another based on their string representations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering class type and type string, including interface checks.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the type string.
